description: Make Nexus feel at home on your desktop.
appearanceHelp: Changes apply immediately. Follow system responds to desktop appearance changes.
saved: Preferences are saved on this device.
aboutHelp: Only appearance and language preferences are operational. All Agent, model, Extension and System information is demonstration data.
aboutHelpLive: Agent, model, Extension and System information comes from read-only scans of this computer. Changes happen only through previewed, system-confirmed plans.
privacyHelp: Nexus stores intent, operation journals and encrypted backups locally. Secrets remain in the OS credential store.
privacyDemoHelp: Browser preview mode does not open a local SQLite database or backup vault.
privacyUnavailable: Local storage metrics are unavailable right now.
retainWindowHelp: Unresolved operations and the latest backup for each configuration file are always kept.
pruneDone: Pruned {{ops}} operations, {{health}} health records and {{backups}} older backups.
diagnosticsHelp: Generate a redacted JSON summary for troubleshooting. Credentials, raw configuration files and environment values are never included.
diagnosticsDemoHelp: Diagnostic export requires the desktop runtime so Nexus can inspect real local state.
copiedDiagnostics: Copied redacted diagnostic JSON to the clipboard.
copyFailed: Clipboard access was denied; use Save JSON instead.
